+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import aiodns
+import pytest
+
+from pyoti.domains import CheckDMARC
+
+
+
+
+DNS_TXT = {
+    "example.com": [("v=spf1 include:_spf.example.com -all", 300)],
+    "_dmarc.example.com": [
+        ("v=DMARC1; p=reject; rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com", 600)
+    ],
+    "missing-dmarc.test": [("v=spf1 include:_spf.example.com -all", 300)],
+    "_dmarc.missing-dmarc.test": [],
+    "none-policy.test": [("v=spf1 include:_spf.example.com ~all", 301)],
+    "_dmarc.none-policy.test": [
+        ("v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com", 601)
+    ],
+    "weak-spf.test": [("v=spf1 include:_spf.example.com ?all", 302)],
+    "_dmarc.weak-spf.test": [
+        ("v=DMARC1; p=quarantine; rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com", 602)
+    ],
+}
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def deterministic_dns(monkeypatch):
+    calls = []
+
+    class DeterministicResolver:
+        def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
+
+            nameservers = kwargs.get("nameservers")
+            if nameservers is None and args and isinstance(args[0], (list, tuple)):
+                nameservers = args[0]
+            calls.append(("init", tuple(nameservers or [])))
+
+        async def query(self, host, record):
+            calls.append(("query", host, record))
+            if host == "dns-error.test":
+                raise aiodns.error.DNSError(4, "Domain name not found")
+            return [
+                SimpleNamespace(text=text, ttl=ttl)
+                for text, ttl in DNS_TXT.get(host, [])
+            ]
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(aiodns, "DNSResolver", DeterministicResolver)
+    return calls
+
+
+def query_events(calls):
+    return [call for call in calls if call[0] == "query"]
+
+
+def assert_txt_query_made(calls, host):
+    assert ("query", host, "TXT") in query_events(calls)
+
+
+def test_query_txt_returns_txt_records_and_empty_list_on_dns_failure(deterministic_dns):
+
+
+
+
+    checker = CheckDMARC("example.com")
+
+    records = checker.query_txt("example.com")
+    assert [(record.text, record.ttl) for record in records] == [
+        ("v=spf1 include:_spf.example.com -all", 300)
+    ]
+
+    assert_txt_query_made(deterministic_dns, "example.com")
+
+    assert checker.query_txt("dns-error.test") == []
+
+    assert_txt_query_made(deterministic_dns, "dns-error.test")
+
+
+def test_check_domain_returns_exact_non_spoofable_result(deterministic_dns):
+
+
+
+
+    checker = CheckDMARC("example.com")
+
+    result = checker.check_domain()
+
+    assert result["domain"] == "example.com"
+    assert result == {
+        "domain": "example.com",
+        "dmarc": {
+            "txt": "v=DMARC1; p=reject; rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com",
+            "ttl": 600,
+        },
+        "spf": {"txt": "v=spf1 include:_spf.example.com -all", "ttl": 300},
+        "spoofable": False,
+    }
+
+    assert_txt_query_made(deterministic_dns, "example.com")
+    assert_txt_query_made(deterministic_dns, "_dmarc.example.com")
+
+
+def test_check_domain_with_default_domain_returns_empty_spoofable_result(
+    deterministic_dns,
+):
+
+
+
+
+    checker = CheckDMARC()
+
+    result = checker.check_domain()
+
+    assert result["domain"] is None
+    assert result == {
+        "domain": None,
+        "dmarc": {},
+        "spf": {},
+        "spoofable": True,
+    }
+
+    assert set(result) == {"domain", "dmarc", "spf", "spoofable"}
+
+
+def test_check_domain_marks_missing_dmarc_as_spoofable(deterministic_dns):
+
+
+
+
+    checker = CheckDMARC("missing-dmarc.test")
+
+    assert checker.check_domain() == {
+        "domain": "missing-dmarc.test",
+        "dmarc": {},
+        "spf": {"txt": "v=spf1 include:_spf.example.com -all", "ttl": 300},
+        "spoofable": True,
+    }
+
+
+def test_check_domain_marks_dmarc_none_policy_as_spoofable(deterministic_dns):
+
+
+
+
+    checker = CheckDMARC("none-policy.test")
+
+    assert checker.check_domain() == {
+        "domain": "none-policy.test",
+        "dmarc": {
+            "txt": "v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com",
+            "ttl": 601,
+        },
+        "spf": {"txt": "v=spf1 include:_spf.example.com ~all", "ttl": 301},
+        "spoofable": True,
+    }
+
+
+def test_check_domain_marks_spf_without_hard_or_soft_all_as_spoofable(
+    deterministic_dns,

+

+    assert checker.check_domain() == {

+        "dmarc": {
+            "txt": "v=DMARC1; p=quarantine; rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com",
+            "ttl": 602,
+        },
+        "spf": {"txt": "v=spf1 include:_spf.example.com ?all", "ttl": 302},
+        "spoofable": True,
+    }

+
+def test_two_checkers_keep_constructor_domain_state_independent(deterministic_dns):
+

+    a = CheckDMARC("example.com")

+
+    a_result = a.check_domain()

+
+
+    assert a_result["domain"] == "example.com"
+    assert b_result["domain"] == "missing-dmarc.test"
+    assert a_result == {
+        "domain": "example.com",
+        "dmarc": {
+            "txt": "v=DMARC1; p=reject; rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com",

+	str := func(v string) *string { return &v }

+	return []*dto.MetricFamily{

+			Type: dto.MetricType_COUNTER.Enum(),

+				Label:       []*dto.LabelPair{{Name: str("pod"), Value: str("demo")}, {Name: str("container"), Value: str("app")}},
+				Counter:     &dto.Counter{Value: flt(12.5)},
+				TimestampMs: integer(1700000000123),
+			}},
+		},
+		{
+			Name:   str("node_memory_working_set_bytes"),
+			Help:   str("Working set memory in bytes"),
+			Type:   dto.MetricType_GAUGE.Enum(),
+			Metric: []*dto.Metric{{Gauge: &dto.Gauge{Value: flt(4096)}}},
+		},
+	}
+}
+
+func TestHandlePodMetricsResourceUsesPrometheusTextContract(t *testing.T) {
+	h := HandlePodMetricsResource(func(context.Context) ([]*dto.MetricFamily, error) {
+		return contractMetricFamilies(), nil
+	})
+	r := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, MetricsResourceRouteSuffix, nil)
+	w := httptest.NewRecorder()
+	h(w, r)
+
+	assert.Equal(t, w.Code, http.StatusOK)
+	assert.Assert(t, strings.Contains(w.Header().Get("Content-Type"), "text/plain"))
+	assert.Assert(t, strings.Contains(w.Header().Get("Content-Type"), "version=0.0.4"))
+	body := w.Body.String()
+	assert.Assert(t, strings.HasPrefix(body, "# HELP "))
+	assert.Assert(t, !strings.HasPrefix(strings.TrimSpace(body), "["))
+
+	families, err := (&expfmt.TextParser{}).TextToMetricFamilies(strings.NewReader(body))
+	assert.NilError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, len(families), 2)
+	cpu := families["container_cpu_usage_seconds_total"]
+	assert.Assert(t, cpu != nil)
+	assert.Equal(t, cpu.GetType(), dto.MetricType_COUNTER)
+	assert.Equal(t, cpu.Metric[0].GetCounter().GetValue(), 12.5)
+	assert.Equal(t, cpu.Metric[0].GetTimestampMs(), int64(1700000000123))
+	labels := map[string]string{}
+	for _, label := range cpu.Metric[0].Label {
+		labels[label.GetName()] = label.GetValue()
+	}
+	assert.Equal(t, labels["pod"], "demo")
+	assert.Equal(t, labels["container"], "app")

+		assert.Assert(t, strings.Contains(w.Header().Get("Content-Type"), "text/plain"))

+

+)
+
+type authResponse struct {
+	token  string
+	expire int
+	raw    string
+}
+
+type authServer struct {
+	t         *testing.T
+	server    *httptest.Server
+	responses []authResponse
+
+	authCount int64
+	mu        sync.Mutex
+	bodies    []map[string]string
+	headers   []string
+}
+
+func newAuthServer(t *testing.T, responses []authResponse) *authServer {
+	t.Helper()
+	s := &authServer{t: t, responses: responses}
+	s.server = httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(s.handle))
+	return s
+}
+
+func (s *authServer) close() {
+	s.server.Close()
+}
+
+func (s *authServer) url() string {
+	return s.server.URL
+}
+
+func (s *authServer) count() int64 {
+	return atomic.LoadInt64(&s.authCount)
+}
+
+func (s *authServer) authBodies() []map[string]string {
+	s.mu.Lock()
+	defer s.mu.Unlock()
+
+	out := make([]map[string]string, len(s.bodies))
+	for i, body := range s.bodies {
+		out[i] = map[string]string{
+			"app_id":     body["app_id"],
+			"app_secret": body["app_secret"],
+		}
+	}
+	return out
+}
+
+func (s *authServer) botInfoHeaders() []string {
+	s.mu.Lock()
+	defer s.mu.Unlock()
+
+	out := make([]string, len(s.headers))
+	copy(out, s.headers)
+	return out
+}
+
+func (s *authServer) handle(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
+
+	switch r.URL.Path {
+	case authPath:
+		n := atomic.AddInt64(&s.authCount, 1)
+		var body map[string]string
+		if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&body); err != nil {
+			s.t.Errorf("auth request body did not decode: %v", err)
+		}
+		s.mu.Lock()
+		s.bodies = append(s.bodies, body)
+		s.mu.Unlock()
+
+		idx := int(n) - 1
+		if idx >= len(s.responses) {
+			idx = len(s.responses) - 1
+		}
+		resp := s.responses[idx]
+		if resp.raw != "" {
+			_, _ = w.Write([]byte(resp.raw))
+			return
+		}
+		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]interface{}{
+			"code":                0,
+			"msg":                 "ok",
+			"tenant_access_token": resp.token,
+			"expire":              resp.expire,
+		})
+	case botInfoPath:
+		s.mu.Lock()
+		s.headers = append(s.headers, r.Header.Get("Authorization"))
+		s.mu.Unlock()
+		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]interface{}{
+			"code": 0,
+			"msg":  "ok",
+			"bot": map[string]interface{}{
+				"activate_status": 1,
+				"app_name":        "Heartbeat Fixture Bot",
+				"avatar_url":      "https://example.invalid/avatar.png",
+				"ip_white_list":   []string{"203.0.113.7"},
+				"open_id":         "ou_fixture_bot",
+			},
+		})
+	default:
+		http.NotFound(w, r)
+	}
+}
+
+func waitFor(t *testing.T, label string, timeout time.Duration, cond func() bool) {
+	t.Helper()
+	deadline := time.Now().Add(timeout)
+	for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
+		if cond() {
+			return
+		}
+		time.Sleep(25 * time.Millisecond)
+	}
+	t.Fatalf("timed out waiting for %s", label)
+}
+
+func requireNoError(t *testing.T, err error) {
+	t.Helper()
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("unexpected error: %T %v", err, err)
+	}
+}
+
+func countFDs(t *testing.T) int {
+	t.Helper()
+	entries, err := os.ReadDir("/proc/self/fd")
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("count /proc/self/fd: %v", err)
+	}
+	return len(entries)

+

+import copy
+import json
+
+import pandas as pd
+
+from deepchecks.core.check_result import CheckFailure, CheckResult
+from deepchecks.core.condition import ConditionCategory, ConditionResult
+from deepchecks.core.suite import SuiteResult
+from tests.common import DummyCheck
+
+
+def _condition(category, name, details):
+    result = ConditionResult(category, details)
+    result.set_name(name)
+    return result
+
+
+def _suite_fixture():
+    checked = CheckResult(
+        {"score": 0.75},
+        header="checked",
+        display=["summary", pd.DataFrame({"metric": ["f1"], "value": [0.75]})],
+    )
+    checked.check = DummyCheck()
+    checked.conditions_results = [
+        _condition(ConditionCategory.PASS, "minimum score", "score is high enough"),
+        _condition(ConditionCategory.WARN, "drift", "small drift"),
+    ]
+
+    hidden = CheckResult({"score": 0.1}, header="hidden", display=None)
+    hidden.check = DummyCheck()
+    hidden.conditions_results = [
+        _condition(ConditionCategory.PASS, "minimum score", "score accepted for this run"),
+    ]
+
+    failure = CheckFailure(DummyCheck(), ValueError("model could not be evaluated"))
+    return SuiteResult(
+        "JSON contract",
+        [checked, hidden, failure],
+        extra_info=["run-id: 17", "partial model inputs"],
+    )
+
+
+def test_suite_json_without_display_roundtrips_state_and_metadata():
+    suite = _suite_fixture()
+
+    payload = json.loads(suite.to_json(with_display=False))
+    assert payload["extra_info"] == ["run-id: 17", "partial model inputs"]
+    assert json.loads(SuiteResult("empty", []).to_json())["extra_info"] == []
+    restored = SuiteResult.from_json(json.dumps(payload))
+
+    assert restored.name == suite.name
+    assert restored.extra_info == ["run-id: 17", "partial model inputs"]
+    assert [isinstance(result, CheckResult) for result in restored.results] == [
+        isinstance(result, CheckResult) for result in suite.results
+    ]
+    assert [result.get_header() for result in restored.results] == [result.get_header() for result in suite.results]
+    check_results = [result for result in restored.results if isinstance(result, CheckResult)]
+    assert all(result.display == [] for result in check_results)
+    assert isinstance(restored.results[-1], CheckFailure)
+
+
+def test_suite_json_roundtrip_preserves_condition_decisions_and_passed_result():
+    suite = _suite_fixture()
+    restored = SuiteResult.from_json(suite.to_json(with_display=False))
+
+    restored_checked = next(result for result in restored.results if result.get_header() == "checked")
+    assert [condition.category for condition in restored_checked.conditions_results] == [
+        ConditionCategory.PASS,
+        ConditionCategory.WARN,
+    ]
+    assert [condition.name for condition in restored_checked.conditions_results] == ["minimum score", "drift"]
+    assert [condition.details for condition in restored_checked.conditions_results] == [
+        "score is high enough",
+        "small drift",
+    ]
+    assert restored.passed(fail_if_warning=False) == suite.passed(fail_if_warning=False) is True
+    assert restored.passed(fail_if_warning=True) == suite.passed(fail_if_warning=True) is False
+
+
+def test_suite_json_with_display_roundtrips_requested_public_display_items():
+    suite = _suite_fixture()
+    restored = SuiteResult.from_json(suite.to_json(with_display=True))
+
+    checked = next(result for result in restored.results if result.get_header() == "checked")
+    assert checked.display[0] == "summary"
+    pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(
+        checked.display[1],
+        pd.DataFrame({"metric": ["f1"], "value": [0.75]}),
+    )
+
+
+def test_suite_json_accepts_legacy_payload_without_extra_info_or_display():
+    payload = json.loads(_suite_fixture().to_json(with_display=False))
+    payload.pop("extra_info", None)
+    legacy_payload = copy.deepcopy(payload)
+    for result in legacy_payload["results"]:
+        if result.get("type") == "CheckResult":
+            result.pop("display", None)
+
+    restored_missing = SuiteResult.from_json(json.dumps(legacy_payload))
+    assert restored_missing.extra_info == []
+    assert all(
+        result.display == []
+        for result in restored_missing.results
+        if isinstance(result, CheckResult)
+    )
+
+    null_display_payload = copy.deepcopy(payload)
+    for result in null_display_payload["results"]:
+        if result.get("type") == "CheckResult":
+            result["display"] = None
+    restored_null = SuiteResult.from_json(json.dumps(null_display_payload))
+    assert all(
+        result.display == []
+        for result in restored_null.results
+        if isinstance(result, CheckResult)
+    )

+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+def _target_body(target_name):
+    lines = Path("Makefile").read_text().splitlines()
+    header = f"{target_name}:"
+    body = []
+    in_target = False
+    for line in lines:
+        if not in_target:
+            if line == header:
+                in_target = True
+            continue
+        if line and not line.startswith(("\t", " ")):
+            break
+        if line.strip():
+            body.append(line.strip())
+    if not in_target:
+        raise AssertionError(f"missing Makefile target {target_name!r}")
+    return " ".join(body)
+
+
+def _tokens(target_name):
+    return _target_body(target_name).split()
+
+
+def _has_mypy_invocation(tokens):
+    return any(token == "mypy" or token.endswith("/mypy") for token in tokens)
+
+
+def test_potype_scope_is_dns_only():
+    tokens = _tokens("potype")
+
+    assert _has_mypy_invocation(tokens)
+    assert "dns/*.py" in tokens
+    assert "examples" not in tokens
+    assert "tests" not in tokens
+
+
+def test_potypetests_target_exists_for_examples_and_tests():
+    tokens = _tokens("potypetests")
+

+    assert "examples" in tokens
+    assert "tests" in tokens
+    assert "dns/*.py" not in tokens

+    """Issue #6XXX: indentation after ON CONFLICT ... DO UPDATE was broken.

+    """
+    in_sql = (

+    )

+        "    id,\n"
+        "    bar\n"
+        ")\n"
+        "values (\n"
+        "    $1,\n"
+        "    $2\n"
+        ") on conflict (id) do update\n"
+        "    set\n"
+        "        bar = $2;\n"
+    )
+    assert _fix_postgres(in_sql) == expected
+
+
+def test_postgres_on_conflict_do_update_with_where_indents() -> None:
+    """ON CONFLICT ... DO UPDATE SET ... WHERE ... should indent SET/WHERE."""
+    in_sql = (
+        "INSERT INTO foo (bar, baz) VALUES (1, 2)\n"
+        "ON CONFLICT (bar) DO UPDATE\n"
+        "SET\n"
+        "baz = 3\n"
+        "WHERE\n"
+        "baz IS NULL;\n"
+    )
+    expected = (
+        "INSERT INTO foo (bar, baz) VALUES (1, 2)\n"
+        "ON CONFLICT (bar) DO UPDATE\n"
+        "    SET\n"
+        "        baz = 3\n"
+        "    WHERE\n"
+        "    baz IS NULL;\n"
+    )
+    assert _fix_postgres(in_sql) == expected
+

+def test_postgres_on_conflict_do_update_multiple_assignments() -> None:
+    """Multiple SET assignments inside DO UPDATE should all be indented."""
+    in_sql = (
+        "INSERT INTO foo (a, b, c) VALUES (1, 2, 3)\n"
+        "ON CONFLICT (a) DO UPDATE\n"
+        "SET\n"
+        "b = 2,\n"
+        "c = 3;\n"
+    )
+    expected = (
+        "INSERT INTO foo (a, b, c) VALUES (1, 2, 3)\n"
+        "ON CONFLICT (a) DO UPDATE\n"
+        "    SET\n"
+        "        b = 2,\n"
+        "        c = 3;\n"
+    )

+package usercase_test_coderl
+
+import (
+	"net"
+	"sort"
+	"strings"
+	"testing"
+
+	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/v2/mongo/options"
+	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/v2/x/mongo/driver/dns"
+)
+
+func init() {
+
+	dns.DefaultResolver = &dns.Resolver{
+		LookupSRV: isolatedLookupSRV,
+		LookupTXT: func(string) ([]string, error) {
+			return nil, nil
+		},
+	}
+}
+
+func isolatedLookupSRV(service, proto, name string) (string, []*net.SRV, error) {
+	if proto != "tcp" {
+		return "", nil, &net.DNSError{Err: "isolated offline unexpected proto", Name: proto}
+	}
+
+	switch {
+	case service == "mongodb" && name == "test1.test.build.10gen.cc":
+	case service == "customname" && name == "test22.test.build.10gen.cc":
+	default:
+		return "", nil, &net.DNSError{Err: "isolated offline no such SRV record", Name: "_" + service + "._" + proto + "." + name}
+	}
+
+	return "", []*net.SRV{
+		{Target: "localhost.test.build.10gen.cc.", Port: 27017},
+		{Target: "localhost.test.build.10gen.cc.", Port: 27018},
+	}, nil
+}
+
+func sortedHosts(hosts []string) []string {
+	copied := append([]string(nil), hosts...)
+	sort.Strings(copied)
+	return copied
+}
+
+func requireValidateError(t *testing.T, opts *options.ClientOptions, scenario string) {
+	t.Helper()
+
+	err := opts.Validate()
+
+	if err == nil {
+		t.Fatalf("Validate() error = <nil>, want validation error for %s", scenario)
+	}
+}
+
+func requireHosts(t *testing.T, label string, hosts []string) {
+	t.Helper()
+
+	if got, want := sortedHosts(hosts), []string{
+		"localhost.test.build.10gen.cc:27017",
+		"localhost.test.build.10gen.cc:27018",
+	}; strings.Join(got, ",") != strings.Join(want, ",") {
+		t.Fatalf("%s Hosts = %v, want %v", label, got, want)
+	}
+}
+
+func TestSRVServiceNameSetterBeforeApplyURIKeepsPollingServiceName(t *testing.T) {
+
+
+	opts := options.Client()
+	if opts.Validate() != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("fresh Validate() = %v, want <nil>", opts.Validate())
+	}
+	if len(opts.Hosts) != 0 {
+		t.Fatalf("fresh Hosts = %v, want []", opts.Hosts)
+	}
+
+	same := opts.SetSRVServiceName("customname")
+	if same != opts {
+		t.Fatalf("SetSRVServiceName returned a different builder")
+	}
+	if opts.Validate() != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("after SetSRVServiceName Validate() = %v, want <nil>", opts.Validate())
+	}
+	if len(opts.Hosts) != 0 {
+		t.Fatalf("after SetSRVServiceName Hosts = %v, want []", opts.Hosts)
+	}
+
+	opts.ApplyURI("mongodb+srv://test1.test.build.10gen.cc")
+	if opts.Validate() != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("after ApplyURI Validate() = %v, want <nil>", opts.Validate())
+	}
+
+	requireHosts(t, "after ApplyURI", opts.Hosts)
+}
+
+func TestSRVServiceNameURIOptionDrivesInitialDiscovery(t *testing.T) {
+
+
+	opts := options.Client().ApplyURI("mongodb+srv://test22.test.build.10gen.cc/?srvServiceName=customname")
+
+	if opts.Validate() != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("Validate() = %v, want <nil>", opts.Validate())
+	}
+
+	requireHosts(t, "", opts.Hosts)
+}
+
+func TestDefaultSRVServiceNameRemainsUnsetAndUsesMongoDBRecords(t *testing.T) {
+
+
+	opts := options.Client().ApplyURI("mongodb+srv://test1.test.build.10gen.cc")
+
+	if opts.Validate() != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("Validate() = %v, want <nil>", opts.Validate())
+	}
+
+	requireHosts(t, "", opts.Hosts)
+}
+
+func TestInvalidSRVServiceNameUsageReportsValidationErrors(t *testing.T) {
+
+
+	requireValidateError(
+		t,
+		options.Client().ApplyURI("mongodb://localhost/?srvServiceName=customname"),
+		"srvServiceName on non-SRV URI",
+	)
+	requireValidateError(
+		t,
+		options.Client().ApplyURI("mongodb+srv://test22.test.build.10gen.cc/?srvServiceName="),
+		"empty srvServiceName",
+	)
+	requireValidateError(
+		t,
+		options.Client().ApplyURI("mongodb+srv://test22.test.build.10gen.cc/?srvServiceName="+strings.Repeat("a", 63)),
+		"63-character srvServiceName",
+	)
+}
+
+func TestSRVServiceNameBuildersKeepIndependentState(t *testing.T) {
+
+
+	a := options.Client().SetSRVServiceName("customname").ApplyURI("mongodb+srv://test1.test.build.10gen.cc")
+	b := options.Client().ApplyURI("mongodb+srv://test1.test.build.10gen.cc")
+
+	if a.Validate() != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("a.Validate() = %v, want <nil>", a.Validate())
+	}
+
+	requireHosts(t, "a", a.Hosts)
+
+	if b.Validate() != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("b.Validate() = %v, want <nil>", b.Validate())
+	}
+
+	requireHosts(t, "b", b.Hosts)
+}

+package moerr_test
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/matrixorigin/matrixone/pkg/common/moerr"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+func TestIsMoErrCodeNilAndDirect(t *testing.T) {
+	ctx := context.Background()
+	div := moerr.NewDivByZero(ctx)
+	require.True(t, moerr.IsMoErrCode(nil, moerr.Ok))
+	require.False(t, moerr.IsMoErrCode(nil, moerr.ErrDivByZero))
+	require.True(t, moerr.IsMoErrCode(div, moerr.ErrDivByZero))
+	require.False(t, moerr.IsMoErrCode(div, moerr.ErrOOM))
+}
+
+func TestIsMoErrCodeWrappedAndNested(t *testing.T) {
+	div := moerr.NewDivByZero(context.Background())
+	wrapped := fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", div)
+	nested := fmt.Errorf("outer: %w", wrapped)
+	require.True(t, moerr.IsMoErrCode(wrapped, moerr.ErrDivByZero))
+	require.True(t, moerr.IsMoErrCode(nested, moerr.ErrDivByZero))
+	require.False(t, moerr.IsMoErrCode(wrapped, moerr.ErrOOM))
+}
+
+func TestIsMoErrCodeJoinedAndPlain(t *testing.T) {
+	div := moerr.NewDivByZero(context.Background())
+	joined := errors.Join(moerr.NewOOM(context.Background()), errors.New("unrelated"), fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", div))
+	require.True(t, moerr.IsMoErrCode(joined, moerr.ErrDivByZero))
+	require.True(t, moerr.IsMoErrCode(joined, moerr.ErrOOM))
+	require.False(t, moerr.IsMoErrCode(errors.Join(errors.New("a"), errors.New("b")), moerr.ErrDivByZero))
+	require.False(t, moerr.IsMoErrCode(errors.New("plain"), moerr.ErrDivByZero))
+}
+
+func TestMoErrErrorsIsMatchesCode(t *testing.T) {
+	internal := moerr.NewInternalError(context.Background(), "first message")
+	wrapped := fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", internal)
+	require.True(t, errors.Is(wrapped, moerr.NewInternalError(context.Background(), "different message")))
+	require.False(t, errors.Is(wrapped, moerr.NewOOM(context.Background())))
+}
+
+func TestConvertGoErrorPreservesDirectMoErr(t *testing.T) {
+	div := moerr.NewDivByZero(context.Background())
+	require.Same(t, div, moerr.ConvertGoError(context.Background(), div))
+}
+
+func TestConvertGoErrorPreservesWrappedMoErr(t *testing.T) {
+	div := moerr.NewDivByZero(context.Background())
+	wrapped := fmt.Errorf("while evaluating expression: %w", div)
+	got := moerr.ConvertGoError(context.Background(), wrapped)
+	require.Same(t, wrapped, got)
+	require.True(t, moerr.IsMoErrCode(got, moerr.ErrDivByZero))
+}
+
+func TestConvertGoErrorPreservesJoinedMoErr(t *testing.T) {
+	div := moerr.NewDivByZero(context.Background())
+	joined := errors.Join(errors.New("annotation"), fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", div))
+	got := moerr.ConvertGoError(context.Background(), joined)
+	require.Same(t, joined, got)
+	require.True(t, moerr.IsMoErrCode(got, moerr.ErrDivByZero))
+}
+
+func TestConvertGoErrorConvertsPlainErrors(t *testing.T) {
+	original := errors.New("disk exploded")
+	got := moerr.ConvertGoError(context.Background(), original)
+	require.Error(t, got)
+	require.True(t, moerr.IsMoErrCode(got, moerr.ErrInternal))
+	require.Contains(t, got.Error(), original.Error())
+	var me *moerr.Error
+	require.True(t, errors.As(got, &me))
+}

+
+def test_load_uses_sorted_regular_files_and_preserves_utf8_lines(tmpdir):
+    _, PlainTextCorpus, _, _ = _corpus_api()
+    root = str(tmpdir)
+    with open(os.path.join(root, "10.txt"), "wb") as stream:
+        stream.write("Đầu tiên\n\nKết thúc\n".encode("utf-8"))
+    with open(os.path.join(root, "2.txt"), "wb") as stream:
+        stream.write("Một dòng".encode("utf-8"))
+    os.mkdir(os.path.join(root, "ignored-directory"))
+
+    corpus = PlainTextCorpus()
+    corpus.load(root)
+
+    assert [document.id for document in corpus.documents] == ["10.txt", "2.txt"]
+    assert corpus.documents[0].sentences == [u"Đầu tiên", u"", u"Kết thúc", u""]
+    assert corpus.documents[1].sentences == [u"Một dòng"]
+
+
+def test_load_replaces_previous_documents(tmpdir):
+    _, PlainTextCorpus, _, _ = _corpus_api()
+    first = str(tmpdir.mkdir("first"))
+    second = str(tmpdir.mkdir("second"))
+    with open(os.path.join(first, "old.txt"), "w") as stream:
+        stream.write("old")
+    with open(os.path.join(second, "new.txt"), "w") as stream:
+        stream.write("new")
+
+    corpus = PlainTextCorpus()

import sys
import tensorflow as tf
import keras.mixed_precision as mp

# --- Fix 1: Keras.Model.compute_loss MRO shadowing ---
# In TF 2.4+, tf.keras.Model gained a compute_loss(self, x, y, y_pred, sample_weight)
# method that shadows loss-mixin compute_loss(self, labels, logits) via MRO.
# Fix: bind the mixin version directly onto each model class, and set None on
# classes that have no loss mixin (so getattr checks in test code work correctly).
from transformers.models.openai.modeling_tf_openai import (
    TFOpenAIGPTModel,
    TFOpenAIGPTLMHeadModel,
    TFOpenAIGPTDoubleHeadsModel,
    TFOpenAIGPTForSequenceClassification,
)
from transformers.modeling_tf_utils import (
    TFCausalLanguageModelingLoss,
    TFSequenceClassificationLoss,
)

TFOpenAIGPTLMHeadModel.compute_loss = TFCausalLanguageModelingLoss.__dict__[\"compute_loss\"]
TFOpenAIGPTForSequenceClassification.compute_loss = TFSequenceClassificationLoss.__dict__[\"compute_loss\"]
TFOpenAIGPTModel.compute_loss = None
TFOpenAIGPTDoubleHeadsModel.compute_loss = None

# --- Fix 2: Removed experimental mixed-precision API ---
# tf.keras.mixed_precision.experimental.set_policy was removed in TF 2.12;
# the replacement is tf.keras.mixed_precision.set_global_policy.
class _Experimental:
    @staticmethod
    def set_policy(policy):
        mp.set_global_policy(policy)

if not hasattr(mp, \"experimental\"):
    mp.experimental = _Experimental()
if not hasattr(tf.keras.mixed_precision, \"experimental\"):
    tf.keras.mixed_precision.experimental = _Experimental()

# --- Run tests ---
import pytest
sys.exit(pytest.main([
    \"tests/test_modeling_tf_openai.py\",
    \"-v\",
    \"--no-header\",
]))
" 2>&1

+
+
+    return {
+        "minute": sorted(schedule.minute),

+        "day_of_month": sorted(schedule.day_of_month),

+

+
+
+
+

+
+    assert actual == expected
+
+
+    assert schedule_snapshot(actual) == schedule_snapshot(expected)
+
+

+
+
+
+
+    actual = crontab.from_string("* * * * SUN")

+    assert actual == expected
+

+
+
+
+
+    actual = crontab.from_string("0 8 5 * *")
+    expected = crontab(minute="0", hour="8", day_of_month="5")
+
+    assert actual == expected
+
+
+    assert schedule_snapshot(actual) == schedule_snapshot(expected)
+
+
+def test_all_five_fields_can_be_specific_values():
+
+
+
+
+    actual = crontab.from_string("15 0 1 1 MON")
+    expected = crontab(minute="15", hour="0", day_of_week="MON", day_of_month="1", month_of_year="1")
+
+    assert actual == expected
+
+
+    assert schedule_snapshot(actual) == schedule_snapshot(expected)
+
+

+
+
+
+
+    actual = crontab.from_string("*/20 9-17 * * MON-FRI")
+    expected = crontab(minute="*/20", hour="9-17", day_of_week="MON-FRI")
+
+    assert actual == expected
+
+
+    assert schedule_snapshot(actual) == schedule_snapshot(expected)
+

+
+
+
+
+    actual = crontab.from_string("59 23 31 12 SAT")

+
+

+
+
+
+

+
+
+
+
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):

+    second = crontab.from_string("0 8 5 * *")

+    expression = "* * * * SUN"

+
+    actual = crontab.from_string(expression)

+
+

+    assert expression == before
+
+
+def test_same_input_matches_fresh_process_result_after_other_calls():
+    expression = "*/20 9-17 * * MON-FRI"
+    in_process = schedule_snapshot(crontab.from_string(expression))
+
+
+
+    assert schedule_snapshot(crontab.from_string("* * * * *")) == schedule_snapshot(crontab())
+
+
+    assert schedule_snapshot(crontab.from_string("59 23 31 12 SAT")) == schedule_snapshot(
+        crontab(minute="59", hour="23", day_of_week="SAT", day_of_month="31", month_of_year="12")
+    )
+
+    script = f"""
+import json
+import sys
+sys.path.insert(0, {os.fsdecode('/workspace/repo')!r})
+from celery.schedules import crontab
+
+def schedule_snapshot(schedule):
+    return {{
+        "minute": sorted(schedule.minute),
+        "hour": sorted(schedule.hour),
+        "day_of_month": sorted(schedule.day_of_month),
+        "month_of_year": sorted(schedule.month_of_year),
+        "day_of_week": sorted(schedule.day_of_week),
+    }}
+
+sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(schedule_snapshot(crontab.from_string({expression!r})), sort_keys=True))
+"""
+    completed = subprocess.run(
+        [sys.executable, "-c", script],
+        check=True,
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,

+
+
+    assert in_process == fresh_process
+
+

+    assert after == before

+    oidc_tokens, client, oauth2_settings
+):
+    """A subclass overriding get_additional_claims(self, request) and
+    returning a dict must have its claims propagated to the userinfo
+    JSON response, and the `request` argument it receives must expose
+    the authenticated user (request.user).
+    """

+	Authorization string
+	ContentType   string

+	FileField     string

+type uploadBackend struct {
+	t      *testing.T
+	server *httptest.Server
+
+	mu      sync.Mutex
+	records []uploadRecord
+	uploads map[string]int
+}

+func newUploadBackend(t *testing.T) *uploadBackend {
+	t.Helper()
+	b := &uploadBackend{
+		t:       t,
+		uploads: make(map[string]int),
+	}
+	b.server = httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(b.handle))

+
+func (b *uploadBackend) URL() string {

+
+func (b *uploadBackend) Records() []uploadRecord {
+	b.mu.Lock()
+	defer b.mu.Unlock()
+	out := make([]uploadRecord, len(b.records))
+	copy(out, b.records)
+	return out
+}
+
+func (b *uploadBackend) handle(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+	if r.URL.Path == "/open-apis/auth/v3/tenant_access_token/internal/" || r.URL.Path == "/open-apis/auth/v3/tenant_access_token/internal" {
+		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")

+		return
+	}
+
+	if r.URL.Path != "/open-apis/im/v1/images" && r.URL.Path != "/open-apis/im/v1/files" {
+		http.NotFound(w, r)
+		return
+	}
+
+	rec, err := readUploadRecord(r)
+	if err != nil {
+		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
+		return
+	}
+	b.mu.Lock()
+	b.records = append(b.records, rec)
+	b.uploads[r.URL.Path]++
+	n := b.uploads[r.URL.Path]
+	b.mu.Unlock()
+
+	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
+	switch r.URL.Path {
+	case "/open-apis/im/v1/images":
+		if n == 1 {
+			_, _ = io.WriteString(w, `{"code":0,"msg":"ok","data":{"image_key":"`+imagePathKey+`"}}`)
+			return
+		}
+		_, _ = io.WriteString(w, `{"code":0,"msg":"ok","data":{"image_key":"`+imageObjectKey+`"}}`)
+	case "/open-apis/im/v1/files":
+		switch n {
+		case 1:
+			_, _ = io.WriteString(w, `{"code":0,"msg":"ok","data":{"file_key":"`+filePathKey+`"}}`)
+		case 2:
+			_, _ = io.WriteString(w, `{"code":0,"msg":"ok","data":{"file_key":"`+fileReaderKey+`"}}`)
+		case 3:

+		}
+	}

+
+func readUploadRecord(r *http.Request) (uploadRecord, error) {
+	mr, err := r.MultipartReader()
+	if err != nil {
+		return uploadRecord{}, err
+	}
+	rec := uploadRecord{
+		Method:        r.Method,
+		Path:          r.URL.Path,
+		Authorization: r.Header.Get("Authorization"),
+		ContentType:   r.Header.Get("Content-Type"),
+		Fields:        make(map[string][]string),
+	}
+	for {
+		part, err := mr.NextPart()
+		if errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
+			break
+		}
+		if err != nil {
+			return uploadRecord{}, err
+		}
+		name := part.FormName()
+		payload, err := io.ReadAll(part)
+		if err != nil {
+			return uploadRecord{}, err
+		}
+		if filename := part.FileName(); filename != "" {
+			rec.FileField = name
+			rec.FileName = filename
+			rec.FileBytes = string(payload)
+			rec.FileSize = len(payload)
+			sum := sha256.Sum256(payload)
+			rec.FileSHA256 = hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
+			continue
+		}
+		rec.Fields[name] = append(rec.Fields[name], string(payload))
+	}
+	for k := range rec.Fields {
+		sort.Strings(rec.Fields[k])
+	}
+	return rec, nil
+}

+	}

+	}
+}

+func sameStringSlicesMap(a, b map[string][]string) bool {
+	if len(a) != len(b) {
+		return false
+	}
+	for k, av := range a {
+		bv, ok := b[k]

+		}
+		for i := range av {
+			if av[i] != bv[i] {

+
